evidence: John Lydon has said directly and repeatedly, including in numerous interviews, that he formed Public Image Ltd in mid-1978 as a deliberate break from the Sex Pistols' punk formula and from punk's growing commercial conformity.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Same singer, opposite record. "Anarchy" is a three-chord shout. "Public Image" opens with a huge, un-punk guitar chime, and Lydon sings about his own manufactured persona rather than trying to provoke the audience.

explanation: Lydon has said plainly, and on the record many times, that he built PiL to get away from what the Sex Pistols, and punk generally, had become. It is one of the most directly self-documented reactions against on this map.
